why: These files work out from positions what a change moved, split, joined or wrapped, and which restored letters an undo step typed. Element ids replace the block guesses and the letter guesses wait for a design of their own, so this code never grows in net.

uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/core/change/range-c: It reads whether a range covers a letter or a whole void. It works out no move, split, join or wrap.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/core/change/text-le: It checks whether a change retained a token span verbatim and aligns a deletion across an adjacent empty text leaf of equal properties. It works out no move, split, join or wrap.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/core/change/v4/appl: It applies closed ID-addressed v4 steps directly by element id and UTF-16 text offset. It works out no move, split, join or wrap from positions.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/core/change/v4/buil: It records closed ID-addressed v4 steps directly from transaction builder primitives as they run. It works out no move, split, join or wrap from positions.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/core/change/v4/extr: It extracts ID-keyed v4 steps between two snapshots by matching permanent element ids. It works out no move, split, join or wrap from positions.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/core/change/v4/inve: It inverts closed ID-addressed v4 steps against the pre-state by element id. It works out no move, split, join or wrap from positions.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/core/change/v4/lowe: It lowers ID-addressed v4 steps sparsely into private RootChange sections using the snapshot element id lookup. It works out no move, split, join or wrap from positions.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/core/change/v4/reba: It transforms and rebases closed 14-op ID-addressed v4 step batches in a 2D OT diamond directly by element id and explicit step op. It works out no move, split, join or wrap from positions.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/core/change/v4/text: It performs UTF-16 1D text, mark, and inline-wrap operational transformation inside a single ID-addressed text-bearing element. It works out no move, split, join or wrap from positions.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/core/change/v4/type: It defines and validates the closed 14-op ID-addressed v4 step schema and property delta helpers. It works out no move, split, join or wrap from positions.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/history/history-fir: It keeps a session step's first write and the redo freeze, and splices a withdrawn step out of the undo list by its identity. It works out no move, split, join or wrap.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/history/history-for: It removes a step the room refused from the undo or redo list by its identity, and records that identity so a resolve drops the step from any kept redo alternative that still holds it. It works out no move, split, join, wrap or restored letter from positions.

It drops each head a forget recorded by its identity while a list resolves, and maps the steps below a run of such heads onto the run's base. It works out no move, split, join, wrap or restored letter from positions.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/history/history-ori: It records each history entry's start document, change, written records, and active window-track state by delegating to core/change/window.ts. It works out no move, split, join, wrap or restored letter from positions.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/history/history-ses: It settles session history replay bases and branch mappings for record-only companion changes, and places a waiting redo by the identities of the undo steps it saw at claim time. It works out no move, split, join, wrap or restored letter from positions.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/history/history-ste: It attaches step ids, facts and carry programs to history batches and freezes snapshots. It works out no move, split, join, wrap or restored letter from positions.
uncounted.packages/plitejs/src/history/history-sto: It stores and publishes per-editor history stacks and transaction drafts. It works out no move, split, join, wrap or restored letter from positions.
